grades.reason: Directly identifies privilege, interrupt-enable, optional watchpoint-enable, and return-PC state restored for general exceptions.
Directly explains ERTN's restored state and additional mode changes for TLB refill exceptions.

grades.quote: When an exception is triggered, if the exception type is not TLB refill exception and machine error exception, the hardware will save the processor core’s privilege level, global interrupt enable bit and watchpoint enable bit at that time to the pre-exception mode information register for restoring the processor core to the context when the exception returns.
